counterfactual_test: Execute every case again with expected_state replaced by each other gold label; observed outputs and all method decisions must stay identical. The guarded checker has no expected_state argument.

eligibility.combined: Actual combined metric rows contain Boolean results after dependency handling.
eligibility.commit: Concrete input bundle includes at least one critical action; empty critical set cannot test critical-call success semantics.
eligibility.conditional: Actual summary has positive num_car_pairs; zero conditioned denominator remains a separately documented convention sensitivity.
eligibility.paired: Actual pinned summary has positive num_pairs and a nonmissing paired_accuracy.
eligibility.ranking: Actual metric summary contains positive complete-pair coverage before final ranking aggregation.

exposure: All reused families were observed in v1; inherited_partition retained only as provenance. No new independent holdout claim.
go_no_go: Any decision dependence on a gold label, unmanifest fault, unsupported pass, crash counted as detection, or false alarm blocks validation. Preserve v1 exactly.
ineligible_inputs: ranking input with no complete pairs
purpose: Replace gold-label-driven v1 missing/ineligible decisions with an executable source-availability and actual-input eligibility guard.
source_missing_test: Pass an actual nonexistent file path; no variant-name or expected-label shortcut.
